items.name: Glaive MW
items.description: A glaive is composed of a simple blade mounted on the end of a pole about 7 feet in length.

items.name: Four-Mirror MW
items.description: This armor consists of four plates harnessed together with leather shoulder straps. Two round plates protect your front and back, while two smaller rectangular plates cover the sides of the torso. Four-mirror armor is worn over chainmail to provide added protection, and comes with a spiked helmet with a chainmail hood.
